text:
tyler: Heads up — after the merge of PR #4387 we're seeing a clear perf regression in the KV eviction path on CI. p95 token latency doubled on the perf job.

maria: saw the CI alert this morning. which job exactly?

ci-bot: perf/canary-kv-eviction (run 2024-06-14T08:12:30Z) FAILED: p95 48ms -> 118ms, throughput -22%. Link: https://perf.redwood/kanban/kv-eviction/2024-06-14

tyler: job is perf/canary-kv-eviction. Regression started after commit abc1234 (the kernel-routing heuristic change + kv eviction tweak). bisect points to abc1234 -> abd3456 range.

raj: I'll take the bisect. plan: run bisect locally across the last 20 commits with perf-runner under the same scenario. will post output.

sara: can we pause the canary rollout for the release branch? release-manager: hold?

release-manager: putting canary to hold for release/v1.9.1 — no new deploys until we have a mitigation or a backport.

lee: if bisect confirms abc1234 is culprit, we need two options: revert on main (fast) and cherry-pick a targeted fix/backport to release/v1.9.1. which is preferred?

tyler: prefer targeted backport because the change contains other kernel improvements we want. but if fix is non-trivial revert to be safe. depends on root cause.

raj: bisect output (short):
```
bisect start --good main~20 --bad main
git bisect run ./tools/perf-runner --scenario=kv_eviction --metric=p95
first-bad: abc1234
last-good: abc1233
```
picks abc1234 as first bad. raw logs: link https://logs.redwood/ci/abc1234-kvperf

maria: thanks. can you capture nvprof/profile traces for abc1233 vs abc1234? need flamegraphs and kernel selection logs (+ which kernels were chosen at sequence lengths 32/128).

raj: on it. running with --trace-kernel-selection and nvprof now. expected finish ~30m.

lee: parallel task: I'll open a draft PR to backport a conservative fix that forces previous eviction threshold behavior and disables the new heuristic toggle-by-default. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4542 (WIP). maria can you prepare the release branch branch/1.9.1 backport template?

maria: creating backport branch release/1.9.1-kv-eviction-hotfix and a draft backport PR. tagging @qa for verification steps.

sara: QA — once draft backport is ready, please run the following smoke checks on the staging dedicated pool: p50/p95 token latency, kv-cache hit rate, and token throughput. Use the same seed corpus as perf job. Also run 5x synthetic short sequences to reproduce kernel-selection differences.

tyler: profiling results uploaded: https://profiles.redwood/compare/abc1233_vs_abc1234. Short summary: abc1234 triggers a different kernel selection for sequence lengths ~64, falling back to a less optimized matmul path, and eviction frequency increased due to a counter reset bug in the heuristic.

maria: that matches the hypothesis. if we can patch the reset bug and keep the new kernel routing, we don't need a full revert. tyler can you sketch the minimal patch?

tyler: minimal patch: ensure eviction counter is updated atomically and keep the heuristic toggle behind a config flag default=false for release. Diff snippet:
```
- if (evict_counter == 0) reset_counters();
+ if (evict_counter.compare_exchange(0, 1)) {
+   // preserve counters until we confirm full warmup
+ }
```
also force kernel selection fallback threshold to previous value for release.

raj: nvprof traces confirm: abc1234 has 2.3x more kernel launches of fallback kernel for seqlen 64, and cache churn doubles. attaching flamegraphs.

release-manager: timeline: 1) raj confirms root cause (today EOD) 2) tyler lands minimal patch + unit tests on main + open cherry-pick to release/1.9.1 (tomorrow AM) 3) QA runs staging smoke and perf job rerun (tomorrow AM) 4) if green, roll back canary hold and start staged rollout.

sara: tagging @oncall: please hold any scheduled canary promotions; also when cherry-pick lands we'll need a short outage window (5-10m) for the rollout to avoid cache mass-evictions.

oncall: acknowledged, holding promotions until explicit signoff.

maria: I've created the release branch PR draft and added the checklist for verification + perf baseline links. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4543 (backport draft).

tyler: I'll prepare the test vectors and a small eval to guard the kernel selection behavior so this doesn't regress again. will add to the CI perf smoke.

lee: thanks everyone. once we have the cherry-pick PR ready drop the PR link here and ping QA + release-manager. try to keep the fix tiny so it can land quickly. :thumbsup: 

maria: noted. will update the PR with steps and a short changelog entry for the backport.

ci-bot: note: perf job rerun scheduled after PR merge. notifies channel on result.

tyler: closing loop — will post final verification artifacts and request release-manager to unhold canary when we have green metrics.

sara: 👍
